title: Monthly to daily: tempify integration
text: Monthly values placed mid-month (day (days_in_month + 1) %/% 2). cyclic PCHIP interpolant (two padding nodes side) evaluated every day. month’s residual (monthly value minus mean daily values) added uniformly days. One pass reproduces monthly mean exactly.  Plain PCHIP passes mid-month values conserve monthly means. uniform correction pchip_mp conserves exactly introduces small steps month boundaries, reported densify_diagnostics(). smoother mean-preserving scheme (full Rymes & Myers 2001 neighbour smoothing) remove steps; candidate improvement tempify.
